source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_source_reported.habit: Normally prostrate stems to 100 cm long
morphology_source_reported.leaves: Variable leaflets ca. 10–30 mm wide; pinnately trifoliolate [key], without glands
morphology_source_reported.inflorescence: Axillary erect peduncles 2–12 cm long; inconspicuous bracts
morphology_source_reported.flowers: 5–8(–10) mm long; genus key gives brick-red to salmon-pink for this species
morphology_source_reported.diagnostics: Only source-region species with pinnately trifoliolate, glandless foliage and usually prostrate stems [key]

habitat_source_reported: Sandy streambanks, roadsides and disturbed places
cautions: Historical taxon concept requires reconciliation before identification-scoring use
Regional habitat does not establish local BONAP nativity
